tasks.title: Order and customer
tasks.statement: Output the order id and the customer name (JOIN customers on customer_id): columns order_id, name; ordered by order id.

tasks.title: With the amount
tasks.statement: Output name, order id and total for all orders (JOIN), ordered by order id.

tasks.title: Filter after JOIN
tasks.statement: Output the name of customers and the ids of their paid orders (status = 'paid'), ordered by order id.

tasks.title: Lines and products
tasks.statement: For order no. 1 output the title and qty of each line (order_items JOIN products), ordered by title.

tasks.title: Three tables
tasks.statement: Output order_id, created and the product title for each line (order_items, orders, products), ordered by order_id, then by title.

tasks.title: Four tables
tasks.statement: Output the customer name, order id, product title and qty for each line: ordered by order, then by title.

tasks.title: USING
tasks.statement: The database has a reference table cities(city, country). When a column has the same name in both tables, the join can be written with USING (city). Output the customer name and country; customers without a city do not appear in the result. Ordered by name.
tasks.hint: JOIN cities ct USING (city) instead of ON c.city = ct.city.

tasks.title: Customers and orders (LEFT)
tasks.statement: Output the customer name and order id; customers without orders must also be in the result (LEFT JOIN, order_id will be NULL). Ordered by name, then by order_id.
tasks.hint: LEFT JOIN keeps all rows of the left table.

tasks.title: Customers without orders
tasks.statement: Output the name of customers who have no orders at all: LEFT JOIN and the condition o.id IS NULL. Ordered by name.

tasks.title: Unsold products
tasks.statement: Output the title of products that were never sold (no rows in order_items), ordered by title.

tasks.title: How many without orders
tasks.statement: How many customers have made no orders at all? Column n.

tasks.title: Condition in ON
tasks.statement: Output the customer name and the id of their paid orders; customers without paid orders must remain (order_id NULL). Put the condition status = 'paid' in ON, not in WHERE. Ordered by name, order_id.
tasks.hint: A condition in WHERE would turn the LEFT JOIN into an inner one.

tasks.title: No paid orders
tasks.statement: Output the name of customers who have no paid orders at all; ordered by name.

tasks.title: RIGHT JOIN
tasks.statement: RIGHT JOIN keeps the rows of the right table. Output the product title and order_id from order_items RIGHT JOIN products; unsold ones will give NULL. Ordered by title, order_id.

tasks.title: Employees and departments
tasks.statement: HR database. Output the employee name and the department name (JOIN departments); employees without a department will not appear in the result. Ordered by employee id.

tasks.title: All employees
tasks.statement: HR database. Output name and the department name for all employees, including those without a department (LEFT JOIN). Ordered by id.

tasks.title: Empty departments
tasks.statement: HR database. Output the names of departments that have no employees.

tasks.title: FULL JOIN
tasks.statement: HR database. FULL OUTER JOIN keeps the rows of both tables. Output e.name and d.name for all pairs, including employees without a department and departments without employees; ordered by e.name, d.name (NULLs come first).

tasks.title: Employee and boss
tasks.statement: HR database. Self-join: output the employee name and the name of their boss (boss) for those who have one; ordered by employee id.
tasks.hint: The same table is taken twice under different aliases.

tasks.title: Without a boss too
tasks.statement: HR database. Output the employee name and the boss; where there is no boss, NULL. Ordered by id.

tasks.title: Pairs with equal salary
tasks.statement: HR database. Find pairs of employees in the same department with equal salary: a.name, b.name, with a.id < b.id so that a pair is not repeated.

tasks.title: Subordinates of Nina
tasks.statement: HR database. Output the name of the subordinates of `Нина Белова` (boss — by name), ordered by id.

tasks.title: CROSS JOIN
tasks.statement: How many rows does the cross join customers CROSS JOIN products give? Column n.
tasks.hint: Each row on the left with each row on the right: 12 × 13.

tasks.title: All combinations
tasks.statement: Output all combinations of product category and order status without repeats: DISTINCT p.category, o.status from products p CROSS JOIN orders o; ordered by category, status.

tasks.title: Row multiplication
tasks.statement: How many rows are in the result of orders JOIN order_items? Column n. The join multiplies rows: each order gets one row per line.

tasks.title: Bought electronics
tasks.statement: Output without repeats the name of customers who bought at least one product of the category `Электроника`; ordered by name.

tasks.title: Bought the SQL book
tasks.statement: Output the name of customers who bought `Книга SQL`; ordered by name, without repeats.

tasks.title: Line totals
tasks.statement: Output order_id, title and the line cost qty * price as line_total for order no. 5; ordered by title.

tasks.title: Top 3 orders with customer
tasks.statement: Output name and total of the three largest orders (the amounts are all different).

tasks.title: Muscovites' revenue
tasks.statement: What is the sum of all orders of customers from Moscow? Column revenue.

tasks.title: Join on inequality
tasks.statement: The tiers table defines price levels (low–high). Output title and the tier name (tiers.name) for each product; join on p.price BETWEEN t.low AND t.high. Ordered by product id.

tasks.title: Premium-tier products
tasks.statement: Output the title of products that fall into the tier `премиум` in the tiers table; ordered by title.

tasks.title: Students and courses
tasks.statement: School database. Output the student name, course title and score for 2024; ordered by name, title.

tasks.title: Fives in math
tasks.statement: School database. Output the name of students who got 5 in the course `Математика` (any year); ordered by name, without repeats.

tasks.title: Courses with no enrollments
tasks.statement: School database. Output the title of courses nobody is enrolled in (no rows in enrollments).

tasks.title: Movie and director
tasks.statement: Movies database. Output the movie title and the director name; do not show movies without a director; ordered by title.

tasks.title: Movie without a director
tasks.statement: Movies database. Output the title and the director name for all movies (LEFT JOIN); where there is no director, NULL; ordered by title.

tasks.title: Directors from the USA and Japan
tasks.statement: Movies database. Output the title of movies by directors from Japan or the USA; ordered by title.
